Description

In the inflamed joint IL-6 binds its soluble receptor, and the pair activates gp130 on nociceptors, which carry little membrane IL-6 receptor of their own. Through JAK, Gab1/2 and PI3K, gp130 activates PKCδ, which sensitises TRPV1 to heat. IL-6 with its soluble receptor sensitises joint nociceptive pathways when injected into the rat knee or applied to the spinal cord, and in people with knee OA synovial fluid IL-6 is associated with pain.

Colour

Each block is coloured by its effect on pain, red where it raises pain and blue where it relieves it, and everything in it takes that colour, GTP and GDP included, as it works for the block's result. Drugs are yellow and classes of molecules white.

This block is red: IL-6 sensitises TRPV1.
